curve.model: binary Weierstrass y^2 + x*y = x^3 + a*x^2 + b

endomorphism.proof_status: Checked Sage verifies pi(G)=lambda*G, exact order 73 for lambda mod r, and the curve/subgroup record.

factor_base.construction: Deterministically scan x coordinates, cofactor-project curve points into the prime-order subgroup, retain 600 signed-Frobenius orbit representatives, and expand all 146 signed rotations.
factor_base.sign_frobenius_quotient_rule: One column per representative; labels are +/- lambda^i mod r for i in 0..72.

field.basis: coefficient of x^i is bit i
field.element_encoding: unsigned polynomial-basis integer with coefficient bit i; decimal strings on JSON interfaces

point_decomposition.cache_policy: Construct factor base, normal basis, root index, and factor-base logarithms before the target-online clock; no cross-run cache.
point_decomposition.summation_polynomial_chain: Closed-form S3 half-trace roots joined through a representative-pair root index; lift four factor-base x coordinates and verify the exact four-point group sum.
point_decomposition.weil_descent_encoding: S3 x-coordinate equations over GF(2^73); normal-basis coordinates represent Frobenius as cyclic rotation.

relation_collection.duplicate_dependency_handling: Incremental modular echelon form; dependent rows are retained in diagnostics but do not increase rank.
relation_collection.precomputation_policy: Generate deterministic known scalars for target-independent pivot-guided factor-log relations; acquire full rank 600.
relation_collection.stop_criterion: Recover all 600 factor-base orbit logarithms, then solve exactly one supplied target.
relation_collection.target_distribution: One frozen, previously unseen public point Q supplied directly; target_count=1.
relation_collection.target_query_policy: Hash public Q coordinates for the target-dependent starting offset; no target scalar is read by the IC producer.
relation_collection.verification: Verify each admitted group relation and independently replay [d]G=Q.

relation_linear_algebra.matrix_construction: 600 signed-Frobenius orbit unknowns with a right-hand side; row coefficients use the four signed-orbit labels.

target_descent.policy: Directly combine the four signed-Frobenius label coefficients with recovered representative logarithms modulo r.
target_descent.success_rule: Verified four-point relation, recovered scalar, and [d]G=Q group check.
